Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/resource_locking.py

src/agent_runtime/resource_locking.py

Python · Tier A

Bind live resource-admission participation to Controller-owned policy revisions.

Responsibilities

  • Define policy/family vocabulary and read current authority through execution-local scopes.

Boundaries

  • Lock participation does not replace capability permissions, execution lifecycle or completion evidence.

Lifecycle

  • Compare expected revision, commit Controller policy, wake scheduling and wait for existing checkpoint coverage when running.

State

  • The config transaction owns revisions; ContextVars carry authority readers and originating family across adapters.

Security

  • Model-supplied snapshots cannot become policy authority; observation never participates in conflict locking.

Collaborators

  • Gateway locking reuses Policy and family rules; native scheduler wake observes policy transitions.

Public surface

  • read/save manage policy; scope/reader retain live authority; participates/pair determine family participation.

@see src/gateway_core/resource_locking.py

@see src/agent_runtime/native/scheduler_wake.py
